question: Does a merged pull request's closingIssuesReferences change when its description is edited after the merge to add a closing keyword for another open issue, and when the issue is linked to it by hand?
pass: Pass if neither the keyword edit nor the manual link adds the new issue N to the merged pull request's closingIssuesReferences, read after each step with the issue's timeline; fail if either does (the working rulings on issue 256, ruling 3). Read on canary pull request 38, merged by P-33, before the edit, after it (at once and a minute later), and after the edit is undone. The manual link is the Maintainer's click and optional; if it is not made, the fixture says it was not tried and the verdict is the keyword edit's alone.
